name: Popover
summary: A generic floating surface anchored to a trigger, for interactive content such as a small form, a calendar or a menu.
useWhen: Interactive content that belongs to one control and should not leave the page context (embed code with a Copy button, quick edit of a title, column settings).
Hosting another component that has to float: the date picker calendar.
Content that must escape a clipping container (table cell, modal, scrolling panel).

dontUseWhen.case: A short, non-interactive hint on hover or focus
A list of actions (Edit, Duplicate, Delete)
Choosing a value from a list
A task that needs full attention or a confirmation (Delete article?)

anatomy.description: The surface: light background, border, radius, shadow, max-height with scroll. position: fixed by default; the createPopover() controller writes top / left inline. Hidden (opacity + visibility) until --open.

attributes.id: Referenced by aria-controls on the trigger
attributes.role: dialog (default) | menu | listbox | grid, set by the controller from its role option
attributes.aria-label: Name of the surface, e.g. "Embed code" (or aria-labelledby a heading inside)

anatomy.description: Padding wrapper (--popover-padding). Leave it out when the content brings its own spacing (e.g. .gds-calendar).
Optional decorative diamond pointing at the trigger. The controller positions it (arrow option).

modifiers.description: Visible. Toggled by the controller together with aria-expanded on the trigger.

states.name: open
states.how: gds-popover--open on the surface + aria-expanded="true" on the trigger (both set by createPopover()).

states.name: closed
states.how: No --open. The element stays in the DOM (it fades out and Floating UI can measure it).

a11y: Trigger: a <button> with aria-haspopup (matching the role), aria-controls = popover id and aria-expanded. createPopover() sets all three.
Surface: a role (dialog by default) and an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby).
Escape and outside click close it; focus moves into the surface on open and back to the trigger on close (controller).
Modal mode traps focus and makes the background inert; use it only when the popover must be finished before going on.
Reduced motion: the open / close transition snaps. Forced colours: the border stays visible.

rules.rule: The trigger has aria-haspopup, aria-controls pointing to the popover id, and aria-expanded matching gds-popover--open.
rules.why: Screen readers announce that the button opens something and whether it is open.

rules.rule: A .gds-popover with role="dialog" has aria-label or aria-labelledby.
rules.why: An unnamed dialog is announced as just "dialog".

rules.rule: Position, open and dismiss the popover with createPopover() from @gjirafa/ds-core; do not hand-write top / left.
rules.why: The controller handles flip, shift, scroll, portal out of clipping parents, Escape and focus return; the CSS alone puts the surface at the top-left of the viewport.
rules.removeInV3: Use CSS anchor positioning once browser support allows, so a CSS-only popover can place itself.

rules.rule: Wrap plain content in __content; put components with their own padding (.gds-calendar) directly in .gds-popover.
Use a popover for interactive content opened by a click; use a tooltip for short text on hover or focus.
rules.why: A popover takes focus and needs a click to open; a tooltip must never hold controls.

knownIssues.issue: .gds-calendar-popover duplicates this surface (same border, radius, shadow) with its own absolute positioning.
knownIssues.fix: Rebuild .gds-calendar-popover on .gds-popover (already planned in the popover docs).

knownIssues.issue: .gds-menu and .gds-dropdown__panel carry their own background, border and shadow. Putting them in a .gds-popover draws two frames.
knownIssues.fix: v3: menu and dropdown panel take their surface from .gds-popover (or get a flat variant).

knownIssues.issue: Without the controller the surface is position: fixed with no coordinates, so it shows at the top-left of the viewport.
knownIssues.fix: Document the controller as required; later add CSS anchor positioning as a fallback.

knownIssues.issue: The arrow is a rotated square in the surface colour with no border, while the surface has a 1px border. The arrow may look cut off from the frame. Needs a visual check.
knownIssues.fix: Give the arrow the same border on its two outer sides.

knownIssues.issue: Open state naming differs across overlays: gds-popover--open, gds-dropdown--open, gds-calendar-popover--open, and is-open on the tooltip and the table action menu.
knownIssues.fix: v3: one convention for every overlay (e.g. --open on the surface).
